newsitem.title: USA: Polaroid Corp names Posa executive VP.
newsitem.headline: Polaroid Corp names Posa executive VP.

text.p: Polaroid Corp said Friday it had appointed Serafino "Sandy" Posa as executive vice president and general manager for its consumer imaging business on a worldwide basis, effective November 8.
Previously, Posa, 42, was senior vice president for business development at Kraft Foods North America, a division of Philip Morris Cos Inc, in Northfield, Ill.
In his new role, Polaroid said Posa will direct sales and marketing to consumers in more than 150 countries, representing about 40 percent of Polaroid's worldwide sales.
Polaroid spokesman Robert Guenther said Posa is filling a new position created by the company's February reorganization.
